sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.text_preview: The `Svc::ActiveTextLogger` component processes log texts from other components. The logs are written to standard output and optionally to a file.

sections.title: 3.2 Functional Description
sections.text_preview: The `Svc::ActiveTextLogger` component provides a text logging function for the software that maintains consistent ordering by writing the logs from a thread.
